item.title: EPA Upends the Endangerment Finding
item.description: A supposedly science-based decision by Barack Obama's administration led to years of burdensome, colossally expensive regulations.

item.title: Friday Short Cuts
item.description: Notable quotables from Barack Obama, Ilhan Omar, Todd Lyons, John Kennedy, Scott Jennings, Donald Trump, Ben Shapiro, and more.

item.title: Dropping My Pack
item.description: Bear your pack as you serve God and be ready to respond when you hear the trumpet call of a believer in need of assistance.

item.title: Profiles of Valor: CAPT Williams and SSG Ollis
item.description: Ordinary men faced with extraordinary circumstances, they summoned the greatest measure of courage to place their lives in imminent peril to save others.

item.title: Climate Conjecture and Rising Insurance Premiums
item.description: Companies have been pushed into a state of fear over a climate that's not producing any more fires, floods, or hurricanes than it has in the past.

item.title: Corporate Fear of LGBTQ Bully Dries Up
item.description: The Human Rights Campaign is losing influence as more Fortune 500 companies are unwilling to participate in its Corporate Equality Index.

item.title: Judge Greenlights Demo Sedition
item.description: A district judge sided with Sen. Mark Kelly in his lawsuit against the DOD for having infringed on his apparent First Amendment right to undermine the commander-in-chief.

item.title: Missing Migrant Minors Found in Minnesota
item.description: Tom Homan says ICE has recovered thousands of Joe Biden's missing unaccompanied minors, which his PR team should be bellowing ad nauseam.

item.title: Friday Executive News Summary
item.description: Inflation rate slows, another partial government shutdown expected, making Obama a poster boy for voter ID, Gallup nixes presidential approval, and more.

item.title: Unmasking ICE Is Just Democrat Subversion
item.description: Yes, it's unsettling to see masked federal agents sweeping city streets, but left-wing violence necessitates a level of protection for officers and their families.
